scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.8 changes shared desktop Sync Group, device-owned sources, import behavior, and the Electron runtime, so the supported macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.8 changes shared desktop Sync Group and device-owned sources, including Windows mirror, preview, and acceptance behavior, so the supported Windows package is required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.8 changes shared desktop synchronization, persistence, import behavior, and the Electron runtime, and repairs Linux packaging provisioning, so Linux Experimental is required.
